active.description:
Colour of the word being spoken and of keywords, as #RRGGBB. Gold (#FFC400) by
default.

fixes.description: Replacement rules applied to the words (fixes.toml).

font.description: Caption font file. Without it, captions use the Anton font that sabicut bundles.

keywords.description: Words that are always drawn in the active colour.

stroke.description: Outline width around caption text, in output pixels. 10 by default.

words.description:
Word timings file (words.json) of the only source, when it has no words of its
own. Ignored when the plan has more than one source: each source then names its
own.

Cut.description: A range of one source clip that is kept in the output.

in.description: Start of the range, in seconds of source time.

out.description: End of the range, in seconds of source time. Must be greater than in.

zoom.description: Punch-in zooms within this cut, in increasing order of at, at least 1 frame apart.

Hook.description: Hook text shown over the opening seconds of the output.

dur.description:
How long the hook stays on screen, in seconds from the start of the output.
At most the length of the output.

text.description: The hook line, for example "Stop leaking your API keys".

fps.description:
Output frame rate in frames per second. Every cut is trimmed to a whole number
of frames at this rate.

OutputSize.description: Output frame size in pixels. Both sides must be even.

crop_x.description: Horizontal centre of the 9:16 crop window, from 0 (left edge) to 1 (right edge).

id.description:
Short name that cuts use to refer to this clip: 1 to 64 letters, digits,
underscores, or hyphens.

words.description:
Word timings file (words.json) of this clip, for the captions. When the plan has
[captions] and more than one source, every source that a cut uses needs one.

at.description:
When the zoom starts, in seconds of source time (not output time). Must be
inside the cut (in <= at < out) and at least 1 frame before out.

description:
A hand-editable description of one short video: the source clips, the ranges kept
from them, and how the result is captioned. Output timing is derived from the cuts
and never stored. Relative paths are resolved from the plan file's directory.

cut.description: Ranges kept from the sources, in output order.

hook.description: Hook text shown over the opening seconds.

schema.description: Plan format version. Always 1 for this schema.

source.description: Source clips. Cuts refer to them by id.

title: Sabicut edit plan (schema v1)
